detail.longDescription: Morning check, day twelve. Optiplex green, 7050 holding, Portainer, Vaultwarden and Gitea up. The 4TB spinner is still at 90%, a personality trait. The UPS beeped at 3am, and after a tinker suggested it I finally ran upsc: scheduled self-test, battery 100%. The beep has been doing homework for a week and the log was too polite to say so. The 7B held the night at five tokens per second. Tape and hope. # homelab # selfhosted
